capacity.selection_rule: Use every eligible primary-family model as a non-averaged envelope; never select after field or lifecycle outcomes.
capacity.parameter_rule: Source-native parameters only; degradation_scalar=1; no recalibration to Liu or Deng.
capacity.calendar_use_rule: Use each model's source-native combined state equations; never add P12 Luh calendar fade to BLAST cycle fade.

rejected_as_primary.E1: one representative daily profile would over-identify an exact life and the Wu core pipeline is not runnable as deposited
rejected_as_primary.E3: no source-supported joint empirical schedule distribution exists for P14 annual mileage scenarios

exposure_generator.design: 17 profiles: one anchor; two one-factor bounds for each of seven dimensions; two coherent joint stress bundles. No full Cartesian grid.
exposure_generator.parked_soc_rule: Emerges from energy balance and pre-selected charging policy; report time share in [0,0.3), [0.3,0.7], and (0.7,1.0]. Never choose a low-SOC policy after observing degradation.
exposure_generator.temperature_rule: Generate cell temperature through a documented thermal layer or bounded cell-temperature proxy; ambient temperature is never substituted directly.
exposure_generator.aggregation_qa: Annual distance and equivalent full-cycle throughput must agree before/after aggregation within 0.5%.

roles.Liu_2025: external validation; maximum attainable status PASS WITH BOUNDS because OCV table is withheld
roles.Qiushi_Wang_2023: method corroboration only; LFP and no public raw telemetry

field_validation.partition: No field record enters fitting or primary-family selection. If a later diagnostic/confirmation split is needed, assign whole vehicles by ascending SHA-256(source_id|vehicle_id): first 60% diagnostic and final 40% untouched confirmation; never split rows from one vehicle.
metrics: absolute retention error in percentage points
median absolute error in percentage points
signed median bias in percentage points
error by age and use strata
observed coverage by the non-averaged model envelope
median envelope width in percentage points

strata.use: source-specific cumulative-mileage tertiles fixed before outcome comparison

thresholds.FAIL: Any PASS WITH BOUNDS threshold missed; any source-specific FAIL; model-domain violation in more than 50% of comparable points; or chemistry/input incompatibility. Overall status is the worst source-specific status.

field_validation.justification: Three percentage points is a practically material SOH error and is above Liu's 0.60% laboratory label-check MAPE; five percentage points accommodates field label and partial-charge uncertainty without treating a wide envelope as validation. Width limits prevent trivial coverage.

resistance.blast_result: BLAST REAL-WORLD RESISTANCE OUTPUT = NOT AVAILABLE / NOT APPROVED
resistance.matching_window_rule: fixed symmetric window; never widen, interpolate, clip, or switch timescale
resistance.central_envelope: P12 Luh source-supported 10th-90th percentiles inside compatible matched states, separately for R10 and R1s
resistance.automotive_outer_envelope: Compatible Schreiber states may expand an outer automotive envelope; contact-sensitive commuter and highway post-knee states remain EXTREME / CONDITIONAL and never define the central envelope.
resistance.prohibited: No midpoint or regression may be reported as deterministic R(t); capacity fade never implies resistance fade.

long_horizon_label: MODEL PROJECTION BEYOND DIRECT FIELD VALIDATION
false_optimum_rejection_rules: depends on one BLAST model when another eligible NMC model reverses it
appears only beyond direct field-validation horizon
depends on RESISTANCE STATE UNSUPPORTED regions
relies only on extreme Schreiber states
depends on one arbitrary parked-SOC assumption
depends on one arbitrary temperature scenario
disappears under reasonable capacity/resistance structural bounds
